subject.name: Microcontroller and Interfacing
subject.source: Syllabus/Diploma_Full_Collection_1/Marwadi_Official_Diploma_Collector/Marwadi_Diploma_Syllabus_Collection/Verified_Syllabi/Diploma Information and Communication Technology/Semester_Unspecified/09CT0505 - Elective 1 Microcontroller and Interfacing.pdf

content: Block diagram of microcontroller, Features of microcontroller
Evolution of microcontroller, Difference between microprocessor
and microcontroller, Microcontroller architecture- Von neuman
and Harward architecture, RISC and CISC
8051 Microcontroller Architecture
Block diagram of 8051, Pin Diagram of 8051, General purpose
registers, Special Function Registers, Oscillator and clock circuit
circuit, Memory Organization, Internal Program and Data Memory
Faculty of Diploma studies
Information and Communication Technology
8051 Assembly Language Programming
Introduction to Program Development Tools(IDE),Concept of
IDE,Editor,Assembler,Compiler,Linker,Simulator,Debugger,Assembler
Directives, Programming model of 8051, Addressing modes, data transfer
instructions, I/O Port programming, Arithmetic and Logical instructions
Bit level instructions, Branching instructions (Jump and loop Jump and
call), Concept of stack, subroutine and related instructions, writing
programs
8051 Timer/Counter and Programming: Use of counter as timer
Timer/Counters and associated registers, Various modes of timer/counter
operations, Time delay programs in Assembly language
8051 Serial Port and Programming: Basics of serial communication
RS232 standards, 8051 connection to RS232, Serial data input/output and
associated registers, Various modes of serial data communication, serial
data communication programs in Assembly language
8051 Interrupts: Concept of Interrupt, interrupt versus polling, Types of
interrupts in 8051, Reset, interrupt control and associated registers
interrupt vectors, Interrupt execution, RETI instruction, software generated
interrupt, interrupt handler subroutine for timer/counter and serial data
transmission/reception in Assembly language
Interfacing of LEDs, 7 Segment display device, LCD display, DIP
Switches, Push Button switches, Key denounce techniques, Keyboard
connections load per key and matrix form, Interfacing A/D converter, D/A
converter, Relay, opto isolator stepper motor and DC motor
Temperature measurement using LM 35 temperature sensor, Battery
voltage monitoring system, Developing Data Acquisition System for
multiple channel inputs, GSM based application, Measurement of speed
